get.summary: The livestreams page: tracked streaming channels, live ones flagged.
The comments page: image comments matching a query.
One image comment.
The filters page: public filters matching a query.
One filter, with the tags it hides and spoilers.
The filters the site provides to everyone.
The signed-in user's own filters. Also the way to check that an API key works.
Recently active forum topics across every forum, newest reply first.
The forums page: every forum with its description and counters.
One forum: its name, description and counters.
The topics of a forum, stickies first and then the most recently replied to.
The topic page: the topic and one page of its posts.
The posts of a topic, oldest first.
One forum post.
The galleries page: galleries matching a query.
The gallery page: the gallery and one page of its images, in gallery order.
Fetch the image page: metadata, counters, media URLs and tags.
The comments of an image, 25 to a page, as the image page lists them.

delete.summary: Take an image off the visitor’s faves.

post.summary: Hide an image from the visitor’s own listings.

get.summary: What the signed-in visitor has done to an image (fave, vote, hide), read from its page.

delete.summary: Take back the visitor’s vote on an image.

post.summary: Upvote (`up: true`) or downvote (`up: false`) an image. Answers its counters.

get.summary: The featured image of the day.

parameters.description: An image page URL such as `https://example.org/images/1`. Only its path matters.
parameters.name: url

get.summary: The embed card of an image page or image file URL, for link previews.
A static page: its title, last update and text.
The posts page: forum posts matching a query.
One forum post by its id, wherever it lives.
The profile page: a user's name, avatar, about text and recent activity.
The site rules page: every rule with its text and examples.
The search page: one page of image results for a query.
Who the visitor is on the site: signed out, or the user they are signed in as.
